instructions:
1. Hold a plank on your forearms or hands with your body in a straight line.
2. Brace your core and keep your hips level.
3. Reach one arm overhead to form an I, then return.
4. Reach the arm out at a 45 degree angle to form a Y, then return.
5. Reach the arm straight out to the side to form a T, then bend the elbow into a W.
6. Switch arms and repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips square to the floor and resist twisting as you lift each arm.
2. Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back during each reach.
3. Move slowly and with control rather than swinging the arm.
4. Keep your neck long and gaze slightly ahead of your hands.

instructions:
1. Start in a push-up position, then walk your hands back and lift your hips into an inverted V.
2. Keep your legs as straight as possible and your head between your arms.
3. Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
4. Press back up to the pike position.
5. Tap one hand to the opposite shoulder while holding the pike, then switch.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Stack your shoulders over your hands to load the deltoids in the pike position.
2. Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag during the shoulder taps.
3. Lower under control rather than dropping your head to the floor.
4. Keep your feet planted and resist rotating your torso during the taps.

instructions:
1. Stand on one leg in front of a box or bench with the other leg extended forward.
2. Hold your arms out in front for balance.
3. Bend the standing knee and sit back until your glutes touch the box.
4. Keep the free leg off the floor throughout.
5. Drive through the standing foot to stand back up.
6. Repeat, then switch legs.
tips:
1. Keep the heel of your standing foot flat on the floor.
2. Control the descent rather than dropping onto the box.
3. Keep your chest up and core braced to stay balanced.
4. Track your knee over your toes and avoid letting it cave inward.

instructions:
1. Start in a plank position on your hands or forearms with your body in a straight line.
2. Brace your core and set your feet about hip-width apart.
3. Lift one arm and reach it straight out in front of you.
4. Hold briefly without letting your hips rotate.
5. Lower the arm and switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips square to the floor and resist twisting toward the lifted arm.
2. Widen your feet for a more stable base if you wobble.
3. Squeeze your glutes and brace your core throughout.
4. Reach in a slow, controlled motion rather than swinging the arm.

instructions:
1. Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
2. Brace your core and keep your hips level.
3. Press one hand to the floor, then the other, to rise into a high plank.
4. Lower back down one forearm at a time to the starting position.
5. Alternate the leading arm each rep.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips as still as possible and resist rocking side to side.
2. Set your feet wider for more stability.
3. Keep your core braced throughout the transition.
4. Move at a steady pace rather than rushing the up and down.
